[[File:Knobby_White_Spider_BTS.png|thumb|right|250px|A [[Knobby white spider/Legends|knobby white spider]]]]
A '''spider''' was a type of arachnid that was commonly found throughout [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. Its familiarity led to its name being shared by [[Knobby white spider/Legends|plants]], other creatures, and even [[Spider droid|droids]] and other technology that mimicked their form. Although most spiders were non-[[Sentience/Legends|sentient]], there were several sentient arachnoid [[Species/Legends|species]], such as the [[Arachnoid]]s, the [[Spider People]], the [[Araquia]], the [[Harch/Legends|Harch]], and the [[Sic-Six/Legends|Sic-Six]].

The word "spider" was often used when naming independent [[Starship/Legends|starships]] throughout [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="SS">{{GamerCite|1|Shipbuilding Secrets}}</ref>
